local_gc_activity_signal.label: permit work types, not a Texas licensed GC census
local_gc_activity_signal.note: Texas has no statewide GC license. These rows are City of San Antonio issued permits with a PRIMARY CONTACT name. They are not a Contractor Connect registration roster and must not be labeled Texas licensed GC.

high_confidence_requires: exact business name + exact government address/phone + one unambiguous candidate. Permit CSV has project address, not contractor address/phone.
